verdicts.evidence: The headline, subhead and buttons in the hero all sit in roughly the left 55% of the page, the right side above the cards is empty white, and there is no image of the product anywhere in the hero.

In card 1 a solid blue "New" badge sits at the far right, "Shared / calendars" wraps onto two lines, and its body and "Learn more" start about 30 px lower (y≈590/672) than in cards 2–4 (y≈560/642), whose grey badges sit right after their headings.
